identificationModule.officialTitle: A Phase I Clinical Study of Dual Specificity CD19 and CD22 Chimeric Antigen Receptor T Cell Therapy in Relapsed or Refractory Acute B Lymphoblastic Leukemia

descriptionModule.detailedDescription: CD19-directed CAR-T cell therapy has shown promising results for the treatment of relapsed or refractory acute B lymphoblastic leukemia. CD19 and CD22 are proteins usually expressed on the surface of the B leukemia cells. The dual specificity CAR enables the T-cells to recognize and kill the tumor cell through recognition of CD19 and CD22.

primaryOutcomes.measure: Occurrence of treatment related adverse events

secondaryOutcomes.description: Objective response include complete remission and partial remission

otherOutcomes.measure: Copy numbers of CAR-T cells in patients
